page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g8ise.large offers a stable resource profile for workloads requiring consistent CPU performance without burstable degradation. It is designed for entry-level general-purpose workloads, such as lightweight web serving, microservices, small-scale databases, and basic development or testing environments.
